title: Sensitivity Meets Sparsity: The Impact of Extremely Sparse Parameter Patterns on Theory-of-Mind of Large Language Models
reasoning: The study utilizes sub-tasks from the MMLU benchmark, specifically 'business ethics' and 'moral scenarios', to evaluate how Theory-of-Mind (ToM) sensitive parameters influence higher-order cognitive reasoning. It finds that these ethical and moral reasoning tasks are significantly impaired when ToM-related parameters are perturbed.
